pytest

# Parallel execution. The suite is subprocess-bound — nearly every test shells out to a
# script in scripts/ — so it ran 97s at 70% CPU on a 10-core machine and 34s with this
# installed. `_pytest_parallel.py` (named from pytest.ini's addopts) switches it on only
# when the import succeeds, so bare `python -m pytest -q` stays the command either way and
# a runner without it is slow rather than broken.
pytest-xdist

graphifyy==0.9.31

# sqlglot is optional at runtime — dbt_column_lineage.py degrades to structural resolution
# without it, the same shape as orjson in _manifest.py. It is not optional for CI. Without
# it every test that exercises the SQL parser skips, and the merge gate reports "test suite
# pass" over a run that never touched the code the change is about.
#
# Pinned like graphifyy above, and for the same reason: the parser decides what the tests
# assert. sqlglot 30 renamed `exp.Select`'s `from` argument to `from_`, which turned every
# edge `unresolved` in silence — an unpinned upgrade moves the results with no diff to point
# at.
sqlglot==30.14.0
